sources.title: A Step Towards Music Generation Foundation Model - GitHub
sources.snippet: 📝 Abstract We introduce ACE-Step, a novel open-source foundation model for music generation that overcomes key limitations of existing approaches and achieves state-of-the-art performance through a holistic architectural design. Current methods face inherent trade-offs between generation speed, musical coherence, and controllability.
